authority: The storage-semiconductor self-verification run now contains two closed point-in-time branches. Supplier-cut/recovery has a six-vintage exact-head trajectory with two Reality rows, four immutable Judgments, one SK hynix reaffirms relation, one explicitly non-direct Samsung Outcome and no-lookahead replay. HBM3E has a four-vintage status trajectory that keeps volume/mass production, customer sampling and future shipment/supply timing separate, plus a two-vintage SK hynix supply trajectory proving the same customer-supply milestone was later realized in March 2024. Because the contemporaneous target was qualitative 'from late March' and later occurrence evidence is month-precision 'March 2024', the direct Outcome is realized while timing remains not_comparable with no synthetic day error. No generic or named-platform qualification Reality has been inferred.
objectives: refine exact supplier cut timing and product scope in the 2022-2023 downturn
separate HBM development, sampling, volume/mass production, customer supply/shipment and platform qualification states
identify and preserve claim-scoped primary-source packets for CAP-0002 grounding
preserve contemporaneous expectations and compare them with later outcomes without hindsight rewrite
comparability_guards: Micron approximately 20% is DRAM+NAND wafer starts versus fiscal Q4 2022 and is Micron-specific.
SK hynix greater-than-50% is 2023 investment YoY, not wafer starts, bit supply or NAND production.
Samsung April 2023 selected-product production-cut wording contains no product split or percentage and is not itself executed-cut Reality.
Samsung Q3 2023 PC/mobile recovery is narrower than the April broad memory forecast; its Outcome remains related_milestone, indeterminate and not_comparable.
HBM development, customer sampling, volume/mass production, customer supply, platform shipment and platform qualification are distinct states.
Samsung HBM3E 8H mass-production Reality and 12H production-plan Judgments are variant-specific and must not be merged.
Samsung 12H customer sampling is not named-customer or named-platform qualification.
SK hynix March 2024 customer-supply realization is direct evidence of the same supply milestone, but month-precision later evidence cannot establish an exact late-March day.
A realized direct Outcome may still have timing_relation=not_comparable when source-supported temporal precision is insufficient.

discovery_notes_below_evidence_authority.source: Micron Fiscal Q3 2024 prepared remarks, June 26 2024
discovery_notes_below_evidence_authority.note: Primary issuer material says Micron's HBM shipment ramp began in fiscal Q3 and it generated over $100 million in HBM3E revenue in the quarter. This is useful later Reality for Micron HBM3E shipment/revenue, but it is not by itself direct proof that NVIDIA H200 platform shipments began in Q2.

Primary issuer results report increasing HBM3E sales/revenue but do not, in the currently discovered claim-scoped text, explicitly establish HBM3E 12H mass-production realization or a named-platform qualification milestone.

next_action: Continue claim-scoped HBM later-vintage recovery without changing platform semantics. Highest-value unresolved targets are a direct primary-source realization of Micron/NVIDIA H200 platform shipment and an explicit Samsung HBM3E 12H mass-production or named qualification status. Preserve Micron June 26 HBM3E shipment/revenue material as a related milestone only if grounded; do not upgrade it to H200-specific realization. Before any new capture/evidence write, refresh current admission from the completed SK hynix Outcome phase to CAP-0001/CAP-0002 source-grounding ownership.
